narr: As a mid-level trough persisted over the Florida Panhandle, abundant low-level moisture and diurnal heating led to plenty of instability in the atmosphere on May 26th. Numerous slow-moving showers and thunderstorms formed in the afternoon across the Miami metro.
ev: A broadcast media member reported flooding across a few roadways and parking lots in South Miami Heights due to heavy rainfall in the area. Rainfall amounts were in the 2 to 4 inch range, most of it falling in 2 hours or less.
